$comment: Project-level bindings for role checks: which command decides each claim in THIS repo. A check with no binding is judged by the model and graded inferential.

tests-red.receipt: the failing test names and their assertion messages, pasted

canon-drift.receipt: the line 'canon check: OK' or the failure list

adr-numbering.receipt: no 'ADR numbering' line in the failure list

citation-resolves.receipt: no canon->meta boundary failure; unresolved paths are still judged by hand

disagreement-rate.receipt: the rate line: N items, M non-unanimous

line-respected.receipt: the summary line; a violation names the item, stations, and instance

quick-start-runs.receipt: the last line of each command

ci-green.receipt: 'canon check: OK' and the test summary lines
